steps.code:
# Get all recommendations by iterating through pages.
access_token = login_result['access_token']
all_recs = []
page_index = 0
page_limit = 20
while True:
    page = apis.spotify.show_recommendations(access_token=access_token, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
    if not page:
        break
    all_recs.extend(page)
    if len(page) < page_limit:
        break
    page_index += 1

print(f"Total recommendations: {len(all_recs)}")
song_ids = [song['song_id'] for song in all_recs]
print(song_ids)
